title: Masked Mandates: artifact (code, scripts and results)
description: Rust prototype, Python bindings, MCP harness, simulators, result files (with environment record and SHA-256 hashes) and the script that generates every number, table and figure of the paper Masked Mandates: Unlinkable, Attenuable and Accountable Delegation for LLM Agents (revised version submitted to IEEE Open Journal of the Computer Society). Version 2.2.1: revised scheme (version 2.2 of the construction), every experiment re-run, attack suite of 96 attacks and 37 checks, and the LaTeX sources of the paper and its supplementary material. Research prototype; not for production use. Code under MIT; result files and generated tables and figures under CC BY 4.0.

creators.name: Ameur, Yulliwas
creators.affiliation: Efrei Research Lab, Université Paris-Panthéon-Assas; Cédric, Cnam

notes: Result files in code/results/ and generated files in manuscrit/ and paper-v2/ (numbers.tex, tab_*.tex, fig_*.pdf) are licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
